description: Free tier terms as stated on each vendor's OWN public pages. Every cell carries the source URL and the date it was read. These are vendor claims, not measurements. If a vendor changes terms, open a PR or an issue with the new source URL.

parlayapi.free_allowance: 1,000 credits/month per the pricing page (the homepage phrases it as 1,000 requests/month; per-endpoint credit costs are published at /v1/meta/credit-costs)
parlayapi.free_tier_delay: Not stated as a delay; free tier includes 48 hours of historical access
parlayapi.book_count_claim: '30+ sportsbooks' on both the homepage and the pricing page
parlayapi.notes: Homepage states the free key covers all 90+ sport keys; pricing page states the free tier never expires.

the_odds_api.card_required: Not stated on the cited page
the_odds_api.free_tier_delay: Not stated on the cited page
the_odds_api.notes: Paid plans listed on the same page: 20K, 100K, 5M, 15M credits/month.

oddspapi.free_allowance: Not published as a fixed number on the pricing page (the page is a build-your-own-plan calculator); a vendor blog post describes a free tier of 250 requests
oddspapi.card_required: 'No credit card required' per vendor blog
oddspapi.free_tier_delay: Not stated on the cited pages
oddspapi.book_count_claim: '350+ bookmakers' (homepage claims 300+ in one section and 350+ elsewhere; both numbers appear on vendor pages)
oddspapi.notes: OddsPapi's pricing is usage-configured (bookmakers x sports x requests). Free tier specifics come from vendor blog posts rather than the pricing page.

sharpapi.free_tier_delay: 60s data delay on free tier; pre-match only (live polling requires Pro+)
sharpapi.book_count_claim: 2 sportsbooks on free tier (DraftKings, FanDuel); '40+ US sportsbooks' overall
sharpapi.notes: Paid plans: Hobby $79/mo, Pro $229/mo, Sharp $399/mo, Enterprise custom (prices as listed on vendor pricing page on the read date).

sportsgameodds.card_required: Not stated on the cited page
sportsgameodds.book_count_claim: 9 bookmakers on free tier; 82+ on top plans
sportsgameodds.notes: Pricing is per event object, not per market/bookmaker combination.

therundown.book_count_claim: '20+ sportsbooks and exchanges' including Kalshi, Polymarket, Novig, ProphetX; free tier includes 3 sportsbooks
therundown.notes: Terms quoted from the structured product data embedded in the vendor's pricing page. Reference endpoints (/sports, /affiliates, /markets) are documented as free regardless of tier.
